name: kernel
description: Persistent Python eval kernel for the current session, holding __main__ across cells. Off by default (kernel.enabled = false). NOT SANDBOXED: cells run in a host python3 subprocess with this process's own filesystem and network reach, and exec_allow is applied to neither %%bash nor subprocess. Every reply carries "sandboxed": false and the reason. The WASI-confined path scripts/setup-python-wasi.sh sets up is test-only and has no production caller, so running that script does not change the posture; see docs/reports/bugs/2026-08-23-kernel-persist-path-is-unsandboxed.md. The cell's environment is this tool's env_allow set, so a variable a cell needs must be named there. Input {kernel:"python"|"js", cell, reset?, timeout_ms?}. Magic prefixes: %pip install, %time, %%bash, !cmd.
llm_description: Session-scoped Python eval kernel; __main__ persists across cells. Disabled unless kernel.enabled=true. NOT sandboxed: a host python3 subprocess with the harness's own filesystem and network reach, and exec_allow covers neither %%bash nor subprocess. Replies say "sandboxed": false. Cells see only the variables in this tool's env_allow. {kernel:'python'|'js', cell, reset?, timeout_ms?}. Magics: %pip, %time, %%bash, !cmd.

cell.description: Code to execute in the persistent kernel.

reset.description: Kill and restart the kernel before this cell.
